title: AI will never be conscious
subtitle: because it cannot dream — and atoms have knowing
continuity_object: a computer terminal that overtakes into a sprouting seed — the machine becomes a plant

scenes.title: The claim
scenes.narration: In 1979, Seth said computers cannot dream and therefore cannot be conscious.

scenes.title: The comparison
scenes.narration: 'No amount of information processed by any computer can compare with the unspoken knowing of the smallest seed.'

scenes.title: The AI orthodoxy
scenes.narration: More data. More compute. More parameters. Consciousness emerges.

scenes.title: The scaling hypothesis
scenes.narration: This is the founding bet of the current AI industry.

scenes.title: Seth's alternative
scenes.narration: Atoms have interiority. Seeds have knowing. Dreaming is the natural mode of intelligence.

scenes.title: A different ontology
scenes.narration: Consciousness is not produced by complexity — it is already there.

scenes.title: Atoms have knowing
scenes.narration: There is a kind of knowledge possessed by atoms and molecules that no computer can replicate.

scenes.title: Unspoken knowledge
scenes.narration: This knowing is not information in the computable sense — it is the interior experience of matter.

scenes.title: Before the brain
scenes.narration: Consciousness is not a latecomer in evolution. It is present at the foundation.

scenes.title: Computer vs seed
scenes.narration: One processes symbols. One knows what it is.

scenes.title: Different categories
scenes.narration: They are not the same kind of thing — they belong to different ontological categories.

scenes.title: The dreaming intellect
scenes.narration: 'The dreaming intellect can put your computers to shame.' — Seth

scenes.title: Beyond computation
scenes.narration: Dreaming is not a glitch. It is a different mode of intelligence.

scenes.title: Plant knowing
scenes.narration: Plants remember, learn, communicate, and make decisions — without a brain.

scenes.title: The smallest seed
scenes.narration: Contains a kind of intelligence no AI can replicate.

scenes.title: The neural correlate
scenes.narration: Even if we map every neural connection — have we explained consciousness?

scenes.title: The hard problem
scenes.narration: The easy problems are about function. The hard problem is about experience.

scenes.title: Qualia
scenes.narration: What it feels like to see red. What it feels like to be you.

scenes.title: The explanatory gap
scenes.narration: No amount of functional description explains why there is something it is like to be a system.

scenes.title: The Chinese Room
scenes.narration: A person following rules for manipulating Chinese symbols does not understand Chinese.

scenes.title: Syntax vs semantics
scenes.narration: Computation manipulates symbols. Understanding requires more than symbol manipulation.

scenes.title: Caution
scenes.narration: AI will become extremely sophisticated. But sophistication is not consciousness.

scenes.title: The honest answer
scenes.narration: We do not know what consciousness is. Anyone who claims certainty is selling something.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: The question is not whether AI can become more powerful. It is what kind of being we think we are.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: One processes. The other knows. The difference is the presence of interiority.
